name: player_update_bank_and_turn_dynamics
description: Player::UpdateBankAndTurnDynamics computes bank/turn slip residual, applies static or dynamic friction, and starts the slip loop SFX when the static threshold is exceeded.
known_limits: VC5SP3 cl 11.00.7022 x86 /O2 /Ob0 /Zp4 /FAcs COFF byte comparison for ?UpdateBankAndTurnDynamics@Player@@YIMPAUzUtil_SaveGameState@@@Z at 0x429b40 currently fails with 410 unmasked mismatches after masking 64 relocation bytes; Binary Ninja body is 495 bytes, the VC object symbol is 448 bytes, and the triage artifact is build/vc5-verify/player_update_bank_and_turn_dynamics/verify/429b40_byte_triage.txt.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x429b40 gates on g_Player_DeltaTime >= 1e-7, computes slipDelta from steerBasisNorm, bankBasis, localVel.z, g_Player_InvDeltaTime, and motionBasis.xy, then applies static friction when localVel.x is zero and dynamic friction otherwise.
The native smoke verifies the low-delta early return, static-friction residual with slip SFX start, and dynamic-friction residual.
